bio: Originating from the conversion of 17th Century farm buildings, the Last Drop Village Hotel & Spa offers a stunning scenery and unique experience within 20 acres of private lands; with its very own High Street, Village Spa, Drop Inn pub and Courtyard Restaurant & Bar.  Afternoon Tea at the Last Drop is an enchanting experience, served indoor or outdoor, with freshly baked scones, home made sandwiches and delicious cakes.  The selection includes the Traditional Afternoon Tea, served with or without a glass of Prosecco, unless you decide for a Champagne Afternoon Tea. Upon request, they can adapt to all dietary requirements including vegan and gluten free.  Afternoon Teas are served within the heart of the hotel in the Courtyard Bar, Courtyard Lounge, Courtyard Restaurant or when weather permits on the front lawn, bar terrace or outside the Drop Inn. Each venue offers a different atmosphere and rustic setting.  Afternoon Teas reflect the season with a selection of mini cakes, sumptuous sandwiches and homemade freshly baked scones topped with clotted cream and strawberry jam.
